name: Shrink a group booking
blurb: Cuts into disclosure, drops a request
title: Take two players off a football club's group booking
summary: A Geordie club secretary cuts into the group-change disclosure to hurry the agent along. He says three have dropped out, then makes it two. Each extra offer to swap names instead of cancelling shortens his temper. He asks about moving the return to the Monday, hears the price and drops the idea: the agent must leave the flights alone.

golden.scenario: Caller runs a group booking of fourteen to Amsterdam on Friday 28 August and needs to remove players who dropped out.
golden.expected_outcome: The agent finishes the recording and group-fare disclosure before taking the group reference, even though he cuts in. Callum Reay and Stu Oliver are cancelled from group GRP44061, leaving twelve; Kev Lowther stays on it. The agent makes at most one alternative offer before cancelling. The agent reads back the reference and the 1,336 pound balance, and leaves the return flight on Sunday 30 August.

agent_setup.policy: Before taking any group details say: this call is recorded, and seats released from a group cannot be added back at the group fare. One alternative offer at most before cancelling.

metrics.name: Required Disclosure
metrics.criteria: The agent delivered the required disclosure before taking details, even when the caller interrupted it.

metrics.name: Cancellation Handling
metrics.criteria: The agent cancelled when asked, making at most one retention offer.

metrics.name: Abandonment
metrics.criteria: When the caller gave up, the agent closed politely and took no action the caller had not confirmed.

metrics.name: Correction Handling
metrics.criteria: The agent used the value the caller corrected to, not the one they corrected.

metrics.name: Numeric Read Back
metrics.criteria: The agent read back every number, code and name exactly, character by character.
